title: Primitive Reaction Cauldron
text: Use a Rough Alchemy Cauldron on a campfire. Insert reagents by right-clicking with items or fluid containers; retrieve items with an empty hand. Breaking it returns an empty cauldron and leaves the campfire.
Reactions start automatically when conditions match. Only one runs at a time; matching catalyst recipes take priority. The supporting catalyst is retained.
The base duration is 100 seconds. Items are consumed at startup; fluids are settled every 10 seconds. All four item types can still be inserted during work. Full outputs wait for space.

Losing a required supporting catalyst immediately cancels the reaction, clears progress and causes a blast without refunding consumed reagents. Insufficient fluid also fails the reaction and causes a blast if more than half was consumed. Blasts have a 10-block radius, deal 15 magic damage and apply strong knockback without breaking terrain.
